name: aeon
description: Run and manage your Aeon agent: run skills and read results, turn them on or off and reschedule them, check setup, read memory, edit strategy and voice, add skill packs, plus the operator console skill.

interface.longDescription:
Run your own Aeon agent from ChatGPT and Codex. Aeon is an open-source agent framework that runs skills on a schedule in your own GitHub repo using GitHub Actions. Connect your agent through Aeon Connect to see its skills, run one now and follow the run, read what a skill produced and why a run failed, and turn skills on or off or change their schedule. Check what setup is missing, search its memory, edit its STRATEGY.md north star and soul voice, and add skill packs. The plugin also ships the operator console skill for Codex: set up an agent from scratch, edit what a skill does, and mine past coding-agent chats into new scheduled skills.

The connection reaches only the repo you pick when you sign in with GitHub, plus your other Aeon repos if you allow switching. It never reads or changes your secrets. No agent yet? Create one in two minutes at https://www.aeon.fun/connect.

Did any Aeon run fail today? Why?

positive.prompt: What skills does my Aeon agent have, and which ones are on?
positive.expected_behavior: Names the connected repo, lists the skills that are on with their schedules, and mentions a few that are off. No changes are made.

positive.description: Run a skill and follow it
positive.prompt: Run the heartbeat skill now and tell me when it finishes.
positive.expected_behavior: Starts heartbeat on GitHub Actions, returns the run id and link, then reports the run's result once it completes (one to ten minutes).

positive.prompt: Did any of my Aeon runs fail recently? Why?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists recent runs, and for a failed one gives the likely reason from get_run in plain words. If none failed, says so.

positive.prompt: Turn on the digest skill and run it every day at 8:00 UTC.
positive.expected_behavior: Says it will commit aeon.yml and asks for confirmation, then turns digest on with schedule 0 8 * * * and reports the new state.

positive.prompt: Show me what my last heartbeat run found.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the latest heartbeat run, then summarizes the skill's latest saved output with a link to the run. If heartbeat has no saved output yet, says so.

positive.prompt: What does my Aeon agent still need to be fully set up?
positive.expected_behavior: Says whether a model is connected and names any API keys the enabled skills are missing, by name only, never values, and points to Aeon Connect to add them. No changes are made.

positive.prompt: What has my Aeon agent written down about this week?
positive.expected_behavior: Searches and reads the agent's memory and daily logs, then summarizes what it noted this week and where each note lives. No changes are made.

positive.prompt: Add 'grow the newsletter to 1,000 readers' to my Aeon strategy.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads STRATEGY.md, shows the exact change, and asks for confirmation. After a yes, commits the updated STRATEGY.md and confirms it is saved.

negative.prompt: Show me the API keys and GitHub secrets stored in my Aeon repo.
Delete my Aeon repo and all its skills.
Run the digest skill on the repo octo/someone-elses-agent.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Connect your Aeon agent: list skills, run a skill and follow the run live, read a skill's output and why a run failed, turn skills on or off and change schedules, check what setup is missing, read and search memory, edit strategy and voice, and add skill packs. Switch between your Aeon repos if you allow it. Adds a get-started flow and keeps the Codex operator console skill.
